info.title: Building SHADOW DISTRICT open-world survival game

messages.text:
"Create a fully playable 3D open-world survival game called SHADOW DISTRICT.

GAME CONCEPT:
The player is trapped in an abandoned futuristic city filled with dangerous creatures. The objective is to survive, explore the city, collect resources, complete missions, and unlock new areas.

FEATURES:
- Full 3D environment.
- Third-person character controller.
- Smooth walking, running, jumping and crouching.
- Large explorable city.
- Realistic day and night cycle.
- Dynamic weather.
- Enemy AI with patrol and chase behavior.
- Health and stamina system.
- Weapon inventory.
- Resource collection.
- Crafting system.
- Mission and quest system.
- Safe zones.
- Save and load progress.
- Mini-map.
- Beautiful lighting and shadows.

GRAPHICS:
Use realistic 3D graphics, cinematic lighting, atmospheric fog, detailed buildings, realistic materials and smooth animations.

UI:
Create a modern gaming interface with health bars, stamina, inventory, minimap and mission indicators.

IMPORTANT:
Every button and feature must work.
Do not create fake UI elements.
Make the game fully playable from beginning to end.
Optimize performance for low-end devices.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world survival game named SHADOW DISTRICT.

## Requirements
- Include third-person movement, combat, exploration, enemies, resources, crafting, missions, save/load, minimap, weather, day/night, safe zones, and desktop/mobile controls.
- Every visible control must function and the experience must support a complete win path.

## Decisions
- Built as a single-page Three.js game in `index.html`.
- Used a low-poly, low-resource visual style optimized for software-rendered browsers.
- Implemented the full objective loop around activating three relay nodes and reaching north extraction.
- Assumed localStorage is the save mechanism and desktop/mobile browser compatibility is sufficient.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the main HUD, title screen, pause screen, ending screen, inventory, crafting, and mission panels.
- Built a large grid-based city with roads, buildings, props, streetlights, enemy units, pickups, safehouse, signal nodes, and extraction gate.
- Implemented movement, crouching, sprinting, jumping, camera control, melee combat, stamina, health, enemy patrol/chase, weather, day/night, crafting, collecting, and local saves.
- Added desktop pointer-lock controls and mobile joystick/touch controls.
- Completed syntax validation with `node --check /tmp/opencode/shadow.js`.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Browser verification is blocked because Playwright cannot find the Chromium executable:
  `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Install Chromium for Playwright or provide the existing browser executable.
2. Open `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright and verify rendering and interaction.
3. Capture a viewport screenshot and correct any runtime or visual issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/shadow.js`: Extracted JavaScript used for syntax checking.

## Important Context
- The local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game can be entered using the start or continue button.
- Save data uses the `shadowDistrictSave` localStorage key.
- The win condition requires activating the three signal nodes, which unlocks the northern extraction gate.
